run.notes: PAIRED A/B, GPU ARM, ABBA. Context sweep at concurrency 1, 4 contexts x 2 output lengths, 3 repeats per pass, TWO passes per arm in ABBA order (CPU, GPU, GPU, CPU) so a linear thermal drift cancels between arms. Each pass started only after a >=120 s cooldown with the CPU package <=50 C and the GPU <=45 C. Figures are the mean of the two passes' per-cell medians; raw min/max span all 6 repeats. BOTH ARMS SERVE THE E4B EXACT Q4_0 GGUF (xbill9/gemma-4-E4B-it-qat-q4_0-exact-gguf, SHA-256 5462cc10, 4,215,695,712 B), the first paired run on E4B. Same protocol, harness, prompts, flags and binaries (by sha256) as the E2B pair's 2026-09-29-paired-sweep; the checkpoint is the only planned change. Both arms: llama.cpp f95b0d9, identical flags except -ngl, -t 6 -tb 12. Thinking ON for every request (sweep.py asks for it; server default --reasoning off). Prompt cache verified defeated: 0 of 28,553 prompt tokens cached in every pass. Host: Lenovo Yoga 9 15IMH5, i7-10750H 6C/12T, GTX 1650 Ti Max-Q, one shared thermal envelope; package throttle events rose 115,310 in CPU pass 1, 6,373 in GPU pass 1, 6,980 in GPU pass 2 and 135,858 in CPU pass 2; the package ended the CPU passes at 85 and 88 C. CPU decode drifted -8.1% (median) from pass 1 to pass 2; ABBA cancels it in the ratio. Arm attested from /proc on both passes: device=gpu, exe=/home/xbill/llama.cpp/build/bin/llama-server, sha256=9f2a8b0b6ed5365d, model /home/xbill/models/gemma-4-E4B-it-qat-q4_0-exact/gemma-4-E4B-it-q4_0-exact.gguf.

model.architecture_notes: Reasoning model: tokens arrive as reasoning_content until the thinking block closes; sweep.py counts both. Gemma 4 E4B (4.5B effective, 8.0B total; llama.cpp reports 7.46B). Exact rebuild: every weight matrix Q4_0 (both embeddings and per_layer_model_proj included), 2.2 MB of F32 norms otherwise. per_layer_token_embd (1.59 GB, 38% of the file) is TENSOR_READ_LAZY.

workload.notes: decode-source auto -> stream; llama-server emits no usage.decode_tokens_per_second, so decode is client-side inter-token latency off the SSE stream. Prompts are device-neutral and identical across arms. prompt_mode=unique (per-request nonce first, so the prefix cache cannot hit). 6 = 3 repeats x 2 ABBA passes.

memory.notes: MEASURED 2026-09-30 on this file from llama-server's -lv 4 allocation log with the serve flags: CUDA0 model 2493.32 MiB, KV 128 + 40 MiB (4 full layers x 8192 cells, 20 sliding layers capped at the 1024-cell window), compute 110.02 MiB; nvidia-smi 2848 MiB of 4096, 3671 MiB free before load. kv_bytes_per_token is the geometry figure from MODELS.md (56 KiB) and over-predicts llama.cpp's allocation, which grows at 16 KiB/token.
